info.name: Retrieving the Storybook : The Story of Axes

descriptions.notStarted: I heard the Helios Tower Library has been ruined. I need to go check it out...
descriptions.inProgress: Wiz the Librarian seemed very concerned about the mix-up of the storybook on The Story of Axes, and he wished to get the story straight and find the storybook that actually does present the story in the right order.
descriptions.completed: Through the request from Wiz the Librarian, I have managed to straighten out the Story of the Axes and acquired the fixed storybook, afterwhich I headed back to Wiz and gave him the book.
